what_works: Full-width hero imagery with minimal text overlay — yacht photography does the entire premium signal. Card-based yacht listings sit on heavy whitespace; the page reads more like a magazine spread than a catalog.
what_does_not_translate: Aspirational-lifestyle hero only works with cinematic photography budget; for trades, the layout (one huge image, minimal text, then card grid) is what to copy.
type_observations: Sans-serif throughout — modern luxury rejection of serif clichés. Type stays small to keep imagery dominant.
